correctness.rationale: For all n, Kummer gives V(n)=2s2(n)-s2(5n). The 8-state transition and four zero-bit flush include every carry exactly. Integer-polynomial certificate (I-zM)Q=D t is checked symbolically (coefficientwise) and gives an unrestricted exact rational series. Eigenvalue factor has simple dominant root 2 at u=1, implicit derivatives 1 and 8/5 giving mean coefficient 1/2, variance 21/20 and rigorous CLT. The standalone finite checks all passed.

value.rationale: For a classical five-ary Fuss–Catalan sequence of combinatorial and arithmetic interest, the natural complete dyadic valuation histogram is not supplied by previously known parity/run-length work. The new exact rational function distinguishes all divisibility strata and determines a nontrivial Gaussian variance 21/20 rather than mere regularity or the zero stratum; it enables every exact finite-block count and asymptotic typical valuation. Risks are bibliographic, not loss of mathematical motivation.
